entries.description: Public MCP server over the MarketNow skills catalog: 8,845 MCP-compatible skills, each carrying a Sentinel L2.5 gVisor-sandbox security audit. Tools: search_skills, get_skill, list_categories, get_manifest, get_install_command. Streamable HTTP + SSE at https://marketnow.site/api/mcp, no authentication for read tools; stdio via npx -y marketnow-mcp.
representativeQueries: search MCP skills for web scraping that passed a security audit
what is the install command for a MarketNow skill
get the manifest of a security-audited MCP marketplace
